newsitem.title: USA: Ametek names Frank Hermance president.
newsitem.headline: Ametek names Frank Hermance president.

text.p: AMETEK Inc said Thursday that Frank Hermance was elected president of the company effective immediately.

The company said he will continue as chief operating officer and a member of the corporate executive office which also includes the chief financial officer and the presidents of AMETEK's three operating groups.
The company said the presidency had been open since 1993.
Before joining AMETEK in 1990, Hermance was general manager of Tektronix's Waveform Measurement division, the world's leading oscilloscope producer.
